# Loom

> Loom is the human–AI workflow and experience engineering companion to the OASIS methodology — implementing Chapter 16: designing workflow blueprints, progressive autonomy, and trust calibration between people and agents.

See [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/INDEX.md) for the complete flat file list.

## Foundations and workflow blueprint

- [Why This Is Engineering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/01-foundations/why-this-is-engineering.md)
- [Principles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/01-foundations/principles.md)
- [Workflow Blueprint Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/02-workflow-blueprint/blueprint-overview.md)
- [Authority and Evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/02-workflow-blueprint/authority-and-evidence.md)
- [Human-AI Workflow Blueprint Template (YAML)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/templates/human-ai-workflow-blueprint.yaml)
